name: The Defias Brotherhood
summary: From Sentinel Hill, Gryan Stoutmantle sends you east to Lakeshire, where a contact may know where the Defias Brotherhood hides.

sections.title: The Threat in the Dust
sections.body: The People's Militia cannot find who directs the bandits. Gryan Stoutmantle needs the cartel's inner circle and its commander exposed before the thieves can be stopped.

sections.title: An Out-of-Town Contact
sections.body: Wiley the Black waits upstairs at the Lakeshire inn. Stoutmantle trusts the rogue's underworld ties to reveal the Brotherhood's hideouts. Whether Wiley can offer a lead is still uncertain.

faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle leads the People's Militia, a ragtag defense force based at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. With Stormwind neglecting the borderlands, he coordinates the defense of the few farmers and refugees still there.

faq.q: Why does Stoutmantle send you to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: The People's Militia has no informants in Westfall's underworld. Gryan Stoutmantle calls on an old favor from Wiley the Black, a rogue at the Lakeshire inn, hoping his criminal ties can reveal who leads the thieves.
Wiley the Black is a rogue staying on the second floor of the Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains. He owes Gryan Stoutmantle a favor and may share underworld rumors and criminal connections.
In Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood's thieves wear red bandanas and have seized farms, roads, and abandoned mines. They drive homesteaders out and challenge Stormwind's authority.

faq.q: Where can I find Wiley in Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Wiley the Black is upstairs on the second floor of the Lakeshire Inn, near the bridge in the Redridge Mountains town of Lakeshire.

faq.q: Does this quest involve any combat?
faq.answer: No. You travel from Sentinel Hill in Westfall across Elwynn Forest to the Lakeshire inn to meet Wiley.

angles.text: As a rogue, you know soldiering alone cannot uncover a criminal syndicate. Stoutmantle turns to someone who understands shadows and street favors: Wiley the Black.
As an Alliance traveler, you cross from Westfall to Redridge, where the outer territories rely on one another while Stormwind neglects them.
